ADMIN_TAB_CHANNELS_DESC: Where players write: everyone, players nearby, or one job. Players switch channels with Tab.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Message length, how long the chat stays on screen, join messages.
ADMIN_C_CHANNEL_DESC: Who reads what is written here.
ADMIN_H_COLOR: Colour of the channel tag and the author, as #RRGGBB.
ADMIN_H_RANGE: Only players this close to the writer read it. 0 means everyone on the server.
ADMIN_H_JOBS: Empty: everyone. Otherwise only characters with one of these jobs see and use the channel.
ADMIN_H_ORDER: Lower comes first; the first channel is where the chat opens.
ADMIN_H_FADE: Seconds the messages stay visible after a new one while the chat is closed.
ADMIN_H_HISTORY: How many messages each player keeps to scroll back.
ADMIN_H_JOINS: Tells everyone when a player joins or leaves.
